description: OpenedShelf Cloudflare WAF Rate Limiting & Abuse Prevention Ruleset

rules.description: Rate limit tag proposal submissions (/submit-tag, /propose) to 10 req/min per IP

response.content: {"error":"Too many submissions. Please wait 60 seconds before submitting another tag.","retry_after":60}

rules.description: Rate limit search API (/search, /api/search) to 60 req/min per IP while protecting metered users
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path in {"/search" "/api/search"}) and http.request.method eq "POST" and not cf.client.bot

response.content: {"error":"Search rate limit exceeded. Please wait a moment.","retry_after":60}

rules.description: Block aggressive AI scraping bots from querying catalog search APIs
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path in {"/search" "/api/search"}) and (cf.bot_management.verified_bot eq false and cf.bot_management.score lt 20 or http.user_agent contains "GPTBot" or http.user_agent contains "CCBot" or http.user_agent contains "Bytespider")

response.content: {"error":"Automated bulk scraping of search endpoints is not permitted. Please use official CC0 database dumps."}
